public_rationale: The reported 2024 projection assigns approximately 73% of revenue to ChatGPT as a whole. That supports subscription importance, but it does not isolate Plus or establish near-total dependence on its growth. The reported 2025 target supplies no product-level bridge from the baseline. The causal conclusion remains unproved rather than disproved.
limitations: Projected revenue share and dependence on future growth are different measurements.
Plus cannot be equated with all ChatGPT subscriptions.
Later changes in the business do not by themselves settle dependence in the original plan.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's revenue goals depend almost entirely on ChatGPT Plus growth because its API business is small.

statement.excerpt: Because access to its APIs isn’t a particularly big business, OpenAI’s hopes of hitting its revenue goals is almost entirely contingent on ChatGPT Plus continuing to grow.

from_speaker: access to its APIs isn’t a particularly big business

our_interpretation: I assess dependence in the revenue plan discussed at publication, rather than whether later revenue targets were achieved.

The ordinary reading is that continued Plus growth was essential and other products offered little independent means of reaching the targets. A majority subscription revenue share alone does not establish this.
Plus means the consumer subscription identified by the speaker. Revenue attributed to all ChatGPT plans cannot automatically be attributed to Plus.

The target period is the latest completed quarter before publication, when the revenue projections discussed in the post were reported. The financial scope records the 2024 projected revenue baseline; the 2025 and 2029 goals are contextual.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous product-level projections show that reaching the stated goals required continued Plus growth, with API and other products contributing little independent growth.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The contemporaneous plan shows a substantial independent route to the targets through API or other products while Plus revenue remains flat.
